assertion: The external plugin contract defines pinned identity, dependency closure, host invocation, activation lifetime, input/result envelopes and existing-operation hook names. The contract preserves standalone resources, core authorization and acceptance boundaries, offline composition and guarded resume semantics. Workflow-changing choices and unresolved host limitations are explicitly routed to the owner workflow decision task. Project defaults, explicit temporary run overrides and frozen effective configuration are defined separately from installed-package state; confirmed installation enables only the exact displayed hooks and readiness effects.
reviewer: Root source review and independent plan_current_source_facts verification against the unchanged immutable assertion
observations: Pinned identity, resource/dependency closure, standalone owned copies and bounded activation retain the existing interface.
Current source checks and authorization guards remain mandatory; plan/contract changes implement no Auto or external-plugin runtime.
Offline composition, result envelopes, guarded attempts/replay and distinct installed/default/frozen configuration remain explicit.
Actual W1/W2 evidence resolves the initial design choices; missing capabilities and further material choices retain prerequisite/owner boundaries.
Exact installation confirmation still binds displayed versions, hooks, enabled state and readiness effects.
limitations: Contract-design revalidation only. Original terminal outcome and immutable assertion remain unchanged; executable integration remains a separate delivery.
